name: MOW_BATCH_ASGN_JOB_ITEMS
description: Batch Assignment Job Item Table. This tabel contains the information of individual job items. Each Item contains a work object Id with up to 3 primary keys.

columns.name: JOB_ID
columns.description: BATCH ID. All job items created from one parent batch assignment job have the same batch id.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: JOB_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Job Item ID, which is an index number within the job items with the same job ID.

columns.name: JOB_ITEM_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Contains a rolling sequence number such that items in the same job item group will have the same value in this column.

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: The request ID of the ESS job.

columns.name: WORK_OBJ_PRIMARY_KEY1
columns.description: Contains the job item's Primary Key 1 of the Work Object

columns.name: WORK_OBJ_PRIMARY_KEY2
columns.description: Contains the job item's Primary Key 2 of the Work Object, if it is available

columns.name: WORK_OBJ_PRIMARY_KEY3
columns.description: Contains the job item's Primary Key 3 of the Work Object, if it is available

columns.name: WORK_OBJ_IDENTIFIER_ATTR
columns.description: Contains the job item's unique identifier attribute value of the Work Object, if it is available

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Contains the error stack trace and error message, whenever an object (job item) fails assignment.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
